jurisdiction: New South Wales, with City of Sydney or Inner West Council property-specific overlays
disclaimer: This is an operational compliance map, not legal advice. Requirements depend on the approved use, building classification, scope of works, patron capacity, licence conditions and final operating model. Confirm with the relevant authority and appropriately licensed professionals before commitment.

register.topic: lawful food premises use and building approval pathway
register.trigger: Before fit-out or change of use
register.requirement: Establish whether existing consent covers the proposed restaurant, café, takeaway, deli, late trading and associated building work. Obtain the correct DA, CDC or other approval and completion evidence where required.
register.authority: Relevant council, registered certifier and NSW planning framework
register.timing: Lease due diligence and before works
register.premises_dependency: Existing consents, approved plans, hours, patron capacity, heritage and work scope

register.trigger: Before commencing food operations
register.requirement: Notify the appropriate enforcement agency and complete council food-business registration process before trading.
register.authority: NSW Food Authority and relevant council
register.premises_dependency: Council process and operator entity

register.trigger: New fit-out, alteration or operation of food premises
register.requirement: Design and construct food rooms, floors, walls, ceilings, fixtures and equipment to the Food Standards Code and council requirements so they are durable, sealed, accessible for cleaning and suitable for the processes.
register.authority: FSANZ, NSW Food Authority and relevant council
register.premises_dependency: Existing finishes, floor waste, penetrations, food flows and approved plans

register.trigger: Retail preparation and service of unpackaged, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food
register.requirement: Appoint at least one Food Safety Supervisor for the premises, hold a recognised current certificate and make the supervisor reasonably available to staff.
register.premises_dependency: Operator and roster

register.trigger: Category one food service activity
register.requirement: Ensure food handlers who perform prescribed activities complete suitable food safety training or can demonstrate adequate skills and knowledge.
register.premises_dependency: Final task allocation

register.trigger: Category one business undertaking prescribed activities
register.requirement: Maintain records or otherwise substantiate critical food safety controls for receiving, storage, processing, cooling, reheating, display and transport as applicable.
register.timing: Each relevant activity and retention period
register.premises_dependency: Recipes, production and record system

register.trigger: Food handling and bar areas
register.requirement: Provide dedicated, conveniently located handwash basins with warm running potable water, hands-free operation where council requires, soap and single-use drying. City guidance calls for food-area basins within 5 m and separate bar handwash facilities.
register.premises_dependency: Room layout and council jurisdiction

register.trigger: Food preparation and reusable equipment or glassware
register.requirement: Provide adequately sized wash facilities. City guidance identifies a double sink or a single sink plus dishwasher, a separate food-preparation sink, cleaners sink, and separate bar wash facilities.
register.authority: Relevant council and Food Standards Code
register.premises_dependency: Menu, dishwasher, bar plan and existing plumbing

register.trigger: Cooking processes producing heat, fumes, smoke, steam or grease
register.requirement: Provide a mechanical exhaust system suitable for the cooking load and compliant with applicable building and ventilation requirements. Obtain required planning, building and commissioning evidence.
register.authority: Relevant council, certifier and NCC framework
register.premises_dependency: Appliances, canopy coverage, airflow, make-up air, duct route, discharge, odour and noise

register.trigger: Grease-producing cooking operation
register.requirement: Set documented filter, hood, duct and fan inspection and cleaning frequencies based on use and fire risk, with contractor records.
register.authority: Fire and Rescue NSW guidance and fire-safety maintenance regime
register.timing: Weekly operator checks and periodic specialist service
register.premises_dependency: System design and cooking load

register.trigger: Discharge of commercial food-process wastewater
register.requirement: Obtain Sydney Water trade wastewater approval and comply with permit conditions before discharge.
register.premises_dependency: Account holder, processes and existing approval

register.trigger: Food premises generating greasy wastewater
register.requirement: Use a correctly sized, Sydney Water-listed pre-treatment device where required, installed by a licensed plumber with access and maintained through the approved servicing arrangement.
register.timing: Design, approval, installation and ongoing service
register.premises_dependency: Existing capacity, ownership, approval, connection, condition and pump-out access

register.trigger: Class 6 premises and building work, subject to applicable concessions and existing-building assessment
register.requirement: Provide access to areas normally used by occupants as required by the NCC and Premises Standards. Have the certifier determine consequences of steps, door widths, gradients, sanitary facilities and proposed work.
register.premises_dependency: Existing entry, levels, building age, work scope and unjustifiable-hardship process if relevant

register.trigger: Occupant count, class and proposed work
register.requirement: Provide sanitary facilities according to calculated occupants and accessibility rules. NSW NCC provisions include a limited small-premises patron-toilet concession, but its application must be determined by the certifier.
register.premises_dependency: Staff and patron count, floor area, sex allocation, existing facilities and access

register.topic: fire safety schedule and annual statement
register.trigger: Where the building has scheduled essential fire safety measures
register.requirement: Identify the fire safety schedule, maintain each measure, arrange competent-person assessment and ensure the owner submits the annual fire safety statement where required.
register.authority: Relevant council and NSW fire-safety framework
register.premises_dependency: Building fire schedule, landlord responsibilities, fit-out changes and occupancy

register.trigger: Before equipment layout and opening
register.requirement: Have the certifier and fire contractor determine extinguisher, blanket, emergency lighting, exit signage, alarm, suppression and separation requirements. Do not infer the required package from listing photos.
register.authority: Certifier, fire contractor and NCC framework
register.premises_dependency: Fire schedule, egress, cooking appliances and building systems

register.trigger: Before equipment purchase and fit-out price lock
register.requirement: Obtain licensed-trade inspections, load schedules and written confirmation of supply, board, metering, gas capacity, hot-water recovery, appliance connection and certification needs.
register.authority: Licensed electrician, gasfitter, plumber and certifier
register.premises_dependency: Existing services and selected equipment loads

register.trigger: Supply of wine, aperitivo or other liquor for on-premises consumption
register.requirement: Hold the correct on-premises licence and comply with approved boundaries, primary-purpose, trading-hours and licence conditions. The restaurant's primary purpose must remain food service under the restaurant authorisation.
register.timing: Before any liquor service and ongoing
register.premises_dependency: Planning approval, community impact, hours, plan, entity and licence history

register.trigger: Licence budget preparation
register.requirement: Obtain the current fee directly from Liquor and Gaming NSW before budgeting or applying. The available fee page observed was effective 15 March 2025 and is not accepted as a current 2026 amount.
register.premises_dependency: Application type and risk loadings

register.trigger: Staff or management supplying or supervising liquor where RSA is required
register.requirement: Ensure affected workers complete recognised RSA training through an approved provider and maintain current competency evidence before liquor duties.
register.timing: Before liquor duties and renewal as required
register.premises_dependency: Roles and licence conditions

register.trigger: Employment covered by MA000119
register.requirement: Classify workers correctly and meet minimum rates, penalty rates, overtime, allowances, breaks and rostering provisions. The planning labour model is not a substitute for a roster-level award calculation.
register.timing: Recruitment, each roster and each payroll
register.premises_dependency: Roles, employment types, ages, days and hours

register.trigger: Eligible employee earnings
register.requirement: Budget and pay the applicable super guarantee. The official current rate used in this model is 12 percent, with payday super noted from 1 July 2026.
register.premises_dependency: Payroll and employee eligibility

register.trigger: Employing workers in NSW
register.requirement: Hold required workers compensation insurance, use the correct industry classification and declare wages. Premium remains UNKNOWN until icare inputs are confirmed.
register.premises_dependency: Entity, wages, classification and claims history

register.trigger: Conducting the business and engaging workers
register.requirement: Identify and control risks including slips, burns, knives, slicers, manual handling, chemicals, gas, electricity, heat, aggression, late work and fatigue; consult workers and maintain training and incident processes.
register.premises_dependency: Final layout, equipment, chemicals, hours and staffing

register.trigger: From 1 July 2026 for businesses with at least 3,960 L weekly general-waste bin capacity; lower thresholds phase in later
register.requirement: Calculate capacity from actual bins and lifts. If at or above the applicable threshold, separate food waste under NSW requirements. Regardless of threshold, design the waste bay so future separation is practical.
register.timing: Lease diligence, waste contract and ongoing threshold review
register.premises_dependency: Actual bin sizes, lift frequency and shared-bin allocation

register.trigger: Food-premises fit-out
register.requirement: Provide a suitable, cleanable, vermin-resistant waste storage area with appropriate access and wash-down arrangements as required by the council-approved design.
register.premises_dependency: Rear access, shared facilities, floor waste and collection route

register.trigger: Reliance on an existing fit-out
register.requirement: Verify ownership, maintenance, approval, serials, capacity and safe operation of every landlord or outgoing-operator asset before assigning reuse value.
register.timing: Before lease commitment and cost plan
register.premises_dependency: Lease disclosure, landlord records and physical inspection

register.trigger: Evening pasta, wine and aperitivo operation
register.requirement: Verify approved hours, noise conditions, acoustic separation, mechanical discharge and odour controls against the intended late-afternoon and evening trade.
register.premises_dependency: Consent, neighbours, duct discharge, music and outdoor areas

register.trigger: Lease negotiation and before trading
register.requirement: Obtain broker advice and quotations for public and product liability, property, equipment breakdown, business interruption, cyber and liquor-related exposures as applicable.
register.timing: Before lease execution or opening as required
register.premises_dependency: Lease insurance clauses, declared values, turnover and liquor activity
